title: Essence of Ether

sources.title: Ether-Essence Slumber
markers: | icon = DRUG Essence of Ether Unfaded Icon.png

summary: Consume one dose to incapacitate yourself with Ether-Essence Slumber for 2 turns.

fields.Slumber: You cannot move or act and automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against you have advantage. Damage or a Shove wakes you.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
